release_status: Release Candidate 1 (RC1) — NOT merged to main. Awaiting review before promotion to Stable, per explicit instruction.
scope: MSME & Entrepreneurship Support Schemes, Food & Agro-Processing Micro-Enterprises, Construction & Skilled Trade Services, Digital & Technology Livelihoods, and China-Inspired Adapted Opportunities for Telangana & Andhra Pradesh (architected to extend to all ~150 briefed industry/livelihood sub-categories and all Indian states without schema change)

datasets_blocked.name: Textile & Garments
datasets_blocked.reason: Extremely large and fragmented category spanning traditional and industrial scales; no tractable narrow slice identified this session
datasets_blocked.unblock_requires: Dedicated research pass with a defined narrower slice agreed with the requester first

datasets_blocked.name: Retail & Local Commerce (general)
datasets_blocked.reason: Grocery, kirana modernization, hyperlocal delivery, tea cafes, organic stores, pet stores individually fragmented with no authoritative registry (the social-commerce angle is already covered in china_inspired_adapted_opportunities.csv)

datasets_blocked.name: Repair & Maintenance Services
datasets_blocked.reason: Mobile/laptop/TV/appliance repair, CCTV/solar installation, EV/bicycle repair individually fragmented with no authoritative registry
datasets_blocked.unblock_requires: Dedicated research pass; likely lower achievable confidence

environment_constraint: Direct WebFetch to .gov.in/.ac.in/.nic.in domains was blocked by this session's organizational egress policy (confirmed HTTP 403 policy denial, re-tested live before collection began). All data collected via WebSearch result snippets only; numeric investment-range figures required a specific citable government project-profile source or were left PENDING_VERIFICATION. Confidence scores capped at 85. See docs/METHODOLOGY.md.
dependencies: No hard foreign-key dependency on Package001_Geography, Package002_Education, or Package003_Healthcare in this release. Datasets in this package characterize livelihood/industry categories, not individually-verified institutions, so the relational model differs from prior packages — see schemas/schema_catalog.json.

source_tiers_used: Tier 4 (Trusted news, for scheme renames and policy transitions)
source_tiers_not_used: Tier 3 (Verified social media — not needed this release)
Tier 5 (Community sources — excluded per package policy for factual data)

confidence_statistics.note: Lower than Package001-003's typical ceilings because this package's core content (investment ranges for livelihood categories) is inherently harder to source to a specific government document than institutional facts. Government-project-profile-grade sources score 70-85; portal-only estimates capped at 58-65. See docs/METHODOLOGY.md.

known_gaps: Field depth is reduced from the ~25 fields per entity named in the package brief to a smaller verifiable core — Machinery, Raw Materials, Suppliers, Business Risks, Opportunities, AI Opportunities, Sustainability, Market Trends, Future Potential, Related Industries, and District Suitability are NOT populated in this release. See docs/METHODOLOGY.md.

Estimated Monthly Revenue Range was dropped from the schema entirely — no reliable public source exists for typical small-business revenue in these categories; attempting it would mean 100% PENDING_VERIFICATION or fabrication risk.
typical_investment_range_summary is PENDING_VERIFICATION for all 12 digital/technology rows and 8 of 13 food/agro-processing rows.
Facebook Marketplace, named in the package brief's own examples, was checked and confirmed NOT officially launched in India.
Telangana's MSME Policy 2024 vs. the older T-IDEA/T-PRIDE framework overlap is unresolved — conflicting subsidy figures found, left PENDING_VERIFICATION rather than guessed.
~145 of ~150 briefed sub-categories not researched in this release (BLOCKED/QUEUED, not guessed).
Coverage limited to Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, and national-level entities — remaining states/UTs QUEUED.
No row has been promoted to VST-VERIFIED; that is a separate governance action.
Government DIC/PMFME project-profile PDFs were located by URL in several cases but their content was only seen via WebSearch snippet, never directly read this session.
